name: SKY & HEART LAST SURVIVAL
source: Sky & Heart Last Survival contains a survival mode similar to the survival modes of the previous games, and ero scenes for a few of the Fei from Baldr Heart. In the survival mode you play as Sou, and you have all weaponry from both Baldr Heart and Baldr Heart EXE aside from the collaboration weapons. Almost all units from Baldr Sky, Baldr Sky DiveX and Baldr Heart are present as enemies (collaboration units from Baldr Sky DiveX are missing).
translation: 《Sky & Heart Last Survival》包含类似前作生存模式的玩法，以及《Baldr Heart》中几名菲的色情场景。在生存模式中，你将扮演宗，拥有《Baldr Heart》和《Baldr Heart EXE》的全部武器（联动武器除外）。《Baldr Sky》《Baldr Sky DiveX》和《Baldr Heart》中的几乎所有单位都会作为敌人出现（《Baldr Sky DiveX》的联动单位不在其中）。
